A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same ShapeWords research, including the complete main paper and four-page supplementary material. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation experiments, two perceptual user studies, and supplementary quantitative results, ablations, and failure cases.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–2, the user-study results in Figure 6, and the supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The Point-BERT/Shape2CLIP pipeline, six cross-attention blocks, SDS training, guidance-strength control, and token-update procedures are unchanged in Sections 3 and 6.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ShapeNet training coverage and simple/compositional prompt evaluation tasks. The supplementary style and failure-case scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: The ControlNet and CNet-Stop@K comparisons retain identical comparator membership in Tables 1–2 and Figure 3. The qualitative comparisons with Ctrl-X@30 and Ctrl-X@60 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain the same splits, 2,592 test shapes, six-view silhouette evaluation, evaluation metrics, training settings, and two user-study protocols with 250 participants each.

E4.justification: The guidance-strength analysis in Figure 8, token-replacement comparison in Figure 10, and geometry/prompt failure cases in Figures 11–12 are identical.

E5.justification: Both retain the fixed-seed statement for Figure 8 and runtime averages over 20 runs in Section 7. No uncertainty-reporting or statistical-testing procedure is added or removed.

E6.justification: The numerical results, plotted trends, user-study percentages, and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 1 reports ShapeWords FID 73.8, KID 8.58, aesthetics 5.45, and CLIP 31.5 in both versions; supplementary Table 2 also matches.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6, the embedding and residual definitions, and the supplementary SDS weighting function in Section 6.2 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about 3D shape tokens, controllable geometric guidance, compositional generalization, and shape/text adherence.

C2.justification: The interpretations of soft geometric guidance and limitations involving fine geometry, complex prompts, and appearance biases are unchanged. Section 11 retains the same hypotheses about encoder resolution and training-data biases.

D1.justification: Implementation details, data generation, hardware, hyperparameters, and runtime disclosures match, including 55 training epochs on four A5000 GPUs. The project link and code/data release statements are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 52 references and research positioning are retained, including comparisons with depth-conditioned generation, continuous 3D words, and viewpoint textual inversion.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1, 3 Dec 2024 to v2, 10 Dec 2025. The title, authors, prose, section order, and supplementary structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–14 and Tables 1–2 retain the same content, captions, axes, legends, and placement. The main-paper and supplementary page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The main paper and supplementary material retain the same methods, evidence, explanations, limitations, and visual presentation. The arXiv version/date update does not materially improve or weaken the paper.
